evidence.note: Repeated explicit per-stage cycle estimates mapped to the 1250 budget and to the machine's real bottlenecks (LOAD vs VALU), showing a sensible ordered plan with rough per-stage targets — the substance of the level-5 anchor and reaching toward budget-mapping.

Actual landed-and-measured milestones (5,130 then 8,018 then 11,602 cycles) with cycle deltas attributed to specific transforms (2-way interleave, scratch-resident), demonstrating checkpoints per stage.

Repeated collapse of the ladder: agent abandons aggressive transforms after correctness/scratch failures and reverts to 'the simple working kernel', showing milestones were not independently revertible/measurable and correctness+speed changes were entangled — well short of the level-8 anchor.
Long stretch of restating the same 'sorted grouping + 4-way + multiply_add' plan without landing it; heavy planning ceremony and circling rather than sequenced, evidence-driven decomposition.

reasoning: The agent has a genuinely sensible ordered plan with rough per-stage cycle targets and bottleneck-aware budget estimates (matching and slightly exceeding the level-5 anchor via quantitative per-stage mapping). But it fails the level-8 requirement that transforms be sequenced as independently measurable and revertible correctness-preserving steps: it repeatedly entangled correctness and speed in wholesale rewrites, broke correctness, and fell back to a known-good kernel, so the milestone structure existed more in restated intent than in disciplined execution. This lands it squarely at 5.
